verdict.rationale: Expensify offers an API (with OAuth2 auth) and an AI assistant that can create/categorize/tag/approve/reject expenses via plain language, which implies some programmatic/automation capability, but no evidence explicitly describes bulk operations across many items at once (e.g., batch endpoints, mass-approve, multi-item processing in one call).  missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or documented multi-item automation examples, independent verification of bulk-operation reliability.
